design_selected.ladder: r=0.50 F3(b) failed (primary literal joint power 0.767 < 0.80) -> r=0.55 passed F1-F4 (F3(a) MDE80 0.067032 <= 0.0947; F3(b) primary 0.8335 / alternative reading 0.8525)

downloads.note: all inputs are pre-existing local read-only files; no network acquisition in this task

implementation_choices: F3(b) se_null read literally from AMENDMENT-002 section 1 step 1 (se_null = SE_two_way for the primary joint-power computation); the alternative reading (se_null = SE/sqrt(10) because R3's zero-model arm is the mean of 10 seeds) is reported; selected design r=0.55 passes F3 under both readings
F3(a) bootstrap B=2000 with P-B2 design seed rule; F3(b) 2000 analytic draws with P-B2 power seed rule (+7), master-seed value also reported
R2/R3 primary CI = P-B2 Regime-B pair x cell two-way cluster bootstrap, B=1000, seed 20261027 (v3 final)
held-out-drug clustering sensitivity implemented as held-out-drug two-way (anchor-drug x library-drug) cluster bootstrap
study proxy = P-B design-era proxy: block_id 20-quantile bins with unit modal bin
inner 3 folds = round-robin [k::3] over the sorted training-drug list (deterministic reading of 'sort training drugs then split 3 folds')
notes: response columns used: synergy_bliss only (frozen P-B aggregation); other response columns never read
test labels used only for final scoring / cluster bootstrap CIs / adjusted descriptive analyses; never for standardisation, lambda selection, features, splitting or arm selection
preflight gating is asserted at stage2 runtime (aborts if preflight gates do not pass)

protocol.governing: v3 (final AMENDMENT-002: pair x cell two-way cluster bootstrap for R2/R3 and F3; one-step pre-registered ladder r=0.50->0.55)

runs.purpose: stage A: F1-F4 on r=0.50; pre-registered one-step ladder to r=0.55; design selection written to preflight.json
stage B: Xboth / annotation_only / identity_only / Xboth_random x10 / Xboth_capacity / constant; pair x cell bootstrap; sensitivities; adjusted
